public.title: Class Variance Authority
public.description: input has base (string), variants (object mapping names to option-to-class objects), defaults (option names), props (overrides) and compounds (array of {when,classes}). Resolve each variant in Object.keys order, use props when present otherwise defaults, omit null choices, append matching compounds in order. Join nonempty base/variant/compound strings with one space. Unknown choices add nothing. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Resolve variant selections before evaluating compound conditions. Time is linear in variants and compound condition keys plus output length; auxiliary space stores selected choices and output. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
